seo_and_admin.admin_ui: Use shadcn/ui components: 'Input' for SEO titles, 'Textarea' for descriptions, 'Switch' for Featured/Draft toggles. Use a custom file upload dropzone for Cover Images.
seo_and_admin.seo_surface: Include React Helmet or Next.js next/head equivalent to inject canonical tags, OG image tags, and JSON-LD structured data (schema.org/BlogPosting) on every article page. Internal links to city/event pages should use standard anchor tags for crawler visibility.

rules: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='blog-share-twitter').
Ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text). The #E81E7C color against white meets requirements for large text, use dark slate for smaller body text.
Include aria-labels for icon-only buttons like social media shares or bookmarks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement an editorial 'digital magazine' feel for the Buddilio blog. Emphasize large imagery and extreme typographical contrast between massive Playfair Display headings and clean sans-serif body text. Avoid generic Shadcn cards for the blog listing—build cardless, image-heavy layouts utilizing the provided Tailwind classes. The reading experience must have a strict measure (max-w-prose) to ensure optimal reading length, with a floating left-rail for sharing. Ensure mobile responsiveness is seamless, collapsing grids to single columns and making the share rail a sticky bottom bar instead.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements and asymmetry.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap (use py-24, py-32).
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that have content underneath.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions). Static = dead.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
